summary: Retain the index locator across API worker restarts

delivery.outcome: Persist a bounded verified index locator across worker restarts so a matching stale baseline can be repaired without scanning untouched legacy archives.
nonGoals: Changing canonical YAML, discovery contracts, or production deployment admission.

architecture.decision: Retain locator contents in the existing SQLite meta table with a conditional write bound to the exact source signature. On a cold repair validate the path and locator stamp, then keep the existing guarded fallback when the snapshot cannot be verified.
architecture.rollback: Revert the source change. Older releases ignore the optional SQLite metadata key.

validation.evidence: Restart canary and guarded legacy-read regression.
Exact-generation CAS, unrelated locator removal and backend tests.
